changelog:
**A shared link to a public page now shows a card, not a bare URL** (#1378). `pageMetadata()` (`src/lib/pageMetadata.ts`) emits `openGraph` and `twitter` blocks built from the same copy as the tab title (#1376). Locale comes from the active language, `siteName` from the vertical's product name, `twitter:card` is `summary_large_image`, and the image URL is absolute through the request-host `metadataBase`.

One shared `next/og` renderer, `src/lib/ogCard.tsx`, draws 1200×630 cards in the request's vertical: Internship CRM blue, or SaleVali magenta on the marketing host. It makes no external fetch, puts no live numbers on a card and carries no PII.

Cards:
- the root card, used by the landing and every public page without its own;
- `/features`, `/for-companies`, `/apply-as-mentor`, `/stories`, `/demo` and `/release-notes`, each with the page's own title and subtitle;
- `/projects/[id]`, with the name and technologies of a **public** project only. A private or unknown id gets the same generic card byte for byte.

Every page names its card route explicitly: a page that sets `openGraph` stops inheriting its ancestors' file-based image, so `/privacy` used to share as a bare link. `/p/[userId]` keeps its own profile card.

e2e: `e2e/og-share-cards.spec.ts`. On six pages it checks `og:title`, `og:description`, an absolute `og:image` / `twitter:image`, `summary_large_image`, the right card route and a 1200×630 PNG. It also checks that a private project's card equals the unknown-id card while a public project's differs.

en: Sharing a page on LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Slack or X now shows a proper preview card with the page's title and a short description, instead of a bare link.
tr: Bir sayfayı LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Slack ya da X'te paylaştığınızda artık çıplak bir link yerine sayfanın başlığını ve kısa açıklamasını gösteren bir önizleme kartı çıkıyor.
de: Wer eine Seite auf LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Slack oder X teilt, sieht jetzt statt eines nackten Links eine Vorschaukarte mit dem Titel der Seite und einer kurzen Beschreibung.

alt.en: The share card for the features page: the product name at the top, the page title and a one-line description
alt.tr: Özellikler sayfasının paylaşım kartı: üstte ürün adı, altında sayfa başlığı ve tek satırlık açıklama
alt.de: Die Vorschaukarte der Funktionsseite: oben der Produktname, darunter der Seitentitel und eine einzeilige Beschreibung
